mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it signals the end of zero-interest-rate policy and imminent monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in nonfarm payrolls and decreases in unemployment rate indicate strengthening labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 600,000 units during a housing recovery phase signal increased construction activity and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 600,000 units during housing recovery, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate above 9.0% signals economic distress and weak corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 9.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production index above 100.5 indicates manufacturing sector expansion, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 100.5, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales indicate robust consumer spending and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of periods when HOUST and RSAFS both increase, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer price index level above 215 (index 1982-1984=100) during high-inflation regime signals persistent inflation, prompting aggressive Federal Reserve rate hikes that increase discount rates and reduce equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 215 during high inflation, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
